Dil dhadakne do is the latest video song of movie Zindagi na milegi dobara. This song captures the spectacular views of spain as well as the chemistry between actors i.e Hrithik roshan, abhey deol, farhan akhtar and katrina kaif. Music is composed by Shankar, Ehsaan, Loy.
Enjoy this awesome video & play only on 'T-Series
Song: Dil Dhadakne Do
Singer: Suraj Jagan, Joi Barua, Shankar Mahadevan
Music Director: Shankar Ehsaan Loy
Lyrics: Javed Akhtar
Music Label: T-Series
